description: Dashboard with details of the container metrics and host OS metrics.

links.tooltip: Search and filter all Unraid logs

panels.description: Busy state of all CPU cores together
panels.title: CPU Busy

panels.description: Busy state of all CPU cores together (5 min average)
panels.title: Sys Load (5m avg)
Syslog errors (24h)
panels.description: Unraid syslog lines at error severity or worse in the last 24 hours. Click through to Unraid Syslog for details.

panels.title: CPU Usage per Container
panels.description: Share of total host CPU used by each container (100% = every thread busy), so it adds up against the CPU Busy card. Whatever the containers don't account for is the Home Assistant VM and the host itself.

panels.title: Received Network Traffic per Container
panels.description: Megabytes per second received by each container. VPN tunnel interfaces (wg*, tun*) are excluded so VPN containers like qBittorrent are not counted twice.

panels.title: Sent Network Traffic per Container
panels.description: Megabytes per second sent by each container. VPN tunnel interfaces (wg*, tun*) are excluded so VPN containers like qBittorrent are not counted twice.

panels.title: Busiest disks (I/O busy %)
panels.description: Share of the selected time range each spinning disk spent doing I/O. Highest = most active. Disks are named by serial number, which stays the same across reboots (sdX letters do not).

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (serial) ((increase(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total{job="unraid-nodeexporter"}[$__range]) and on(device,instance) (node_disk_ata_rotation_rate_rpm{job="unraid-nodeexporter"} > 0)) * on(device,instance) group_left(serial) node_disk_info{job="unraid-nodeexporter"}) / $__range_s

panels.title: Disk throughput (read + write)
panels.description: Combined read and write rate per spinning disk, named by serial number.

targets.expr: sum by (serial) (((rate(node_disk_read_bytes_total{job="unraid-nodeexporter"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total{job="unraid-nodeexporter"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(device,instance) (node_disk_ata_rotation_rate_rpm{job="unraid-nodeexporter"} > 0)) * on(device,instance) group_left(serial) node_disk_info{job="unraid-nodeexporter"})

panels.title: Errors and kernel problems (OOM, hung tasks, I/O)

targets.expr: {job="unraid-syslog"} |~ "(?i)out of memory|oom-kill|oom_reaper|hung task|blocked for more than|call trace|i/o error|machine check|segfault|soft lockup|hard lockup|ata[0-9]+.*(error|failed|reset)"
